state: Goal `core-math-3-3`: `Core\Math::min`, `Core\Math::mod` and `Core\Math::round` carry every proof — about.md, three examples, a bench with a fresh record, an attack and a `covers:` Rust test each — and their reference cards in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/math.rs` are in the plain voice. backlog: `Core\Math::round(1.005, {precision: 2})` returns `1` and PHP 8.5 returns `1.01`. `Core\Math::format` does the same. `a_precision_rounds_at_that_place` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/math.rs` and `docs/examples/core/Math/format/about.md` pin it, and no rule records the difference. It needs a decision: match PHP, or record the difference as a divergence.
Spec § 3 (`docs/spec/01-core-library.md:401`) gives `round` a `float|decimal` parameter. The registry row takes `float` only. Not checked further.
The goal's remaining members after the next group: `sin`, `sinh`, `tan`, `tanh`, `toBase`, `toDegrees` and `toRadians`.
